### Рабочий путь

`opencode serve` на `127.0.0.1:4096` (официальный клиент, basic auth) — запрос из myCoder через `OpenCodeServeClient` с `modelID = big-pickle` вернул «OK». Это подтверждено live-тестом: прямой Zen — BLOCKED (ожидаемый `freeTierError`), локальный `opencode serve` — PASS.

Изменения myCoder по итогам: `OpenCodeRequestContext` приведён к официальному контракту (заголовки, `Accept: */*`, `Authorization: Bearer public`, формат `ses_`/`msg_`, 40-hex project id), `x-opencode-project` больше не содержит путь файловой системы.

## Итоговое правило ворот (бисекция 25 октября 2026)

Гипотеза «нужен официальный системный промпт» из предыдущего раздела опровергнута финальной бисекцией тела запроса при неизменных официальных заголовках. Форма ворот состоит из трёх независимых проверок.

### 1. Форма запроса — 403 `FreeTierError`

| Условие | Результат |
| --- | --- |
| `stream: true` + инструмент с `function.name` ровно `read` | 200, поток ответа |
| `stream: false` (любое тело, любые инструменты) | 403 `FreeTierError` |
| `stream: true`, но `tools` пуст | 403 `FreeTierError` |
| `stream: true`, инструмент назван иначе (`bash_tool`, `read_file`) | 403 `FreeTierError` |
| `stream: true`, `read` + произвольные описания/схемы инструментов | 200 |
| `stream: true`, `read` + любой `tool_choice` (`none`/`auto`/`required`) | 200 |
| официальный title-промпт без инструментов | 200 (legacy-путь title) |
| официальный title-промпт с инструментами | 403 |

Значения заголовков правило не меняет: официальный набор заголовков с «чужим» телом даёт 403, а минимальный корректный набор даёт 200.

### 2. Окружение в system-сообщении — 429 `FreeUsageLimitError`

При верной форме запроса (`stream: true` + инструмент `read`) остаётся проверка окружения. Без неё inference-сервис отвечает 429 вместо ответа модели:

| Условие | Результат |
| --- | --- |
| system-сообщение с блоком `<env> … Working directory: … </env>` | 200 |
| `<env></env>` без строки `Working directory:` | 429 |
| блок `<environment>` вместо `<env>` | 429 |
| блок `<env>` в user-сообщении | 429 |
| блок `<env>` в system + произвольный текст рядом | 200 |
| `Working directory: /` (любой путь) | 200 |

Официальный промпт opencode содержит ровно такой блок (`packages/opencode/src/session/system.ts`): `Working directory`, `Workspace root folder`, `Is directory a git repo`, `Platform`, `Today's date`.

### 3. Форма идентификаторов

`packages/schema/src/identifier.ts` (v1.19.4): 26 символов = 12 hex от метки времени + 14 base62; `current = BigInt(timestamp) * 0x1000n + counter`, значение для сессий инвертируется (`~current`), для сообщений — нет; префиксы `ses_` и `msg_`. Проект — 40 hex либо `global`.

| Форма `x-opencode-session` | Результат |
| --- | --- |
| upstream-форма (инвертированное время), свежая метка | 200 |
| upstream-форма, метка на 30 минут старше | 200 |
| upstream-форма, метка на 2 часа старше | 429 |
| upstream-форма, метка из будущего | 429 |
| без инверсии (как у сообщений) | 429 |
| SHA-256-форма myCoder (произвольные 12 hex) | 429 |
| `x-opencode-request` старше 6 часов | 429 |

Вывод: upstream декодирует из идентификатора метку времени, поэтому идентификатор сессии обязан быть инвертированным и свежим, а идентификатор запроса — свежим на каждый запрос. SHA-256-идентификаторы myCoder декодировались как случайное время и отвергались всегда — это и была причина постоянного 429.

### 4. Регистрация сессии и квота

Зарегистрированная upstream сессия (идентификатор из захваченного официального запроса) продолжает работать: с ней тело myCoder (`<env>` + инструмент `read` + `stream: true`) возвращает 200. Новый `ses_`-идентификатор сейчас отвергается с 429 `FreeUsageLimitError` при любом теле — включая тело самого официального клиента, который на этом же IP тоже не получает ответ. Это исчерпание анонимной квоты на регистрацию новых сессий, а не дефект контракта myCoder.

- 403 `FreeTierError` — ворота client-identity/формы запроса.
- 429 `FreeUsageLimitError` — либо отсутствует блок `<env>`, либо неприемлема форма/свежесть идентификаторов, либо исчерпана анонимная квота по IP и модели. Docker на этой машине использует тот же egress IP и отвечает тем же 429.

### Что делает myCoder

`MiCoderAutoFreeClient` шлёт официальный контракт (`OpenCodeRequestContext`: `authorization: Bearer public`, `user-agent: opencode/1.19.4 ai-sdk/provider-utils/4.0.23 runtime/bun/1.4.4`, `x-opencode-client: desktop`, `x-opencode-project`, `x-opencode-session`, `x-opencode-session-id`, `x-opencode-request`, `accept: */*`) и всегда `stream: true`.

- `MiCoderAutoFreeClient.messagesWithEnvironment` добавляет system-сообщение с блоком `<env>` (рабочая директория, корень проекта, git-репозиторий, платформа, дата), если такого блока ещё нет.
- `OpenCodeRequestContext` генерирует идентификаторы в upstream-формате: `ses_` — инвертированное время, `msg_` — прямое; идентификатор сессии один на чат и сохраняется между запусками (иначе каждая реплика начинала бы новую сессию), идентификатор запроса — свежий на каждый HTTP-запрос.
- Минимальные запросы (каталог моделей, суммаризация, проба провайдера) несут один инструмент `read` с `tool_choice: none`; агентный цикл — полный набор инструментов с официальными именами (`read`, `write`, `edit`, `bash`, `webfetch`, `todowrite`) и `tool_choice: auto`, а ответы с `tool_calls` исполняются локальным исполнителем инструментов.

Живая проверка 25 октября: прямой Zen-запрос myCoder с корректным `<env>` и upstream-идентификаторами возвращает 429 `FreeUsageLimitError` — ворота (403) пройдены, отказ вызван исчерпанием анонимной квоты на регистрацию новой сессии с этого IP (официальный клиент на том же IP отказывается так же).

Key facts to document:
- The same request bytes (URL, method, headers, body) sent by different HTTP clients at the same minute:
  - Bun (BoringSSL — the stack of the official client) → 200 (many times, 4 header variants, both with and without a trailing newline).
  - curl / python urllib / node fetch / Swift URLSession (SecureTransport) → 429 FreeUsageLimitError with `retry-after` = the seconds until 00:00 UTC.
- The egress IP is identical for all clients (49.237.66.63) → not an IP-bucket difference between clients; but the Cloudflare edge differs: bun → cf-ray …-SEA, curl → …-DEN.
- A Chrome UA with curl → 403 FreeTierError "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode." → the upstream checks the client identity.
- Conclusion: the anonymous free tier is served to the official client's HTTP/TLS stack; a native Swift client lands in the quota-limited path. The working product path remains `opencode serve`.

Let me write the doc update now, then commit+push the OpenCode work (rotation + docs).

input.newString:
### 5. Транспортный уровень: кому достаётся анонимная квота

Один и тот же запрос (одинаковые URL, метод, набор и значения заголовков, тело побайтово) отправлен разными HTTP-клиентами в пределах одной минуты:

| Клиент | TLS-стек | Результат |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bun` fetch (официальный стек opencode) | BoringSSL | **200**, поток ответа модели |
| `curl` | OpenSSL | 429 `FreeUsageLimitError`, `retry-after` = секунды до 00:00 UTC |
| `python urllib` | OpenSSL | 429 `FreeUsageLimitError` |
| `node fetch` | OpenSSL | 429 `FreeUsageLimitError` |
| Swift `URLSession` (myCoder) | SecureTransport | 429 `FreeUsageLimitError` |

Проверено, что дело не в заголовках и не в теле: `bun` с любым из вариантов заголовков (нижний регистр, `Connection: keep-alive`, `Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br, zstd`) отвечает 200, `curl` с теми же заголовками — 429; перевод тела в 707 или 708 байт (с завершающим переводом строки) результата не меняет; egress IP у всех клиентов одинаковый (`49.237.66.63`); HTTP/1.1 и HTTP/2 результата не меняют.

Отличается только краевой маршрут Cloudflare: у `bun` `cf-ray` оканчивается на `SEA`, у `curl` — на `DEN`. С подменой User-Agent на браузерный `curl` получает 403 `FreeTierError`: «OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode».

Вывод: анонимный free tier отдаётся только клиенту с официальным HTTP/TLS-стеком, остальные попадают в путь с суточной квотой на IP. Для нативного Swift-клиента прямой Zen-вызов закрыт на стороне upstream, поэтому рабочим путём для myCoder остаётся `opencode serve` (официальный клиент на localhost).

### Что делает myCoder

 - Минимальные запросы (каталог моделей, суммаризация, проба провайдера) несут один инструмент `read` с `tool_choice: none`; агентный цикл — полный набор инструментов с официальными именами (`read`, `write`, `edit`, `bash`, `webfetch`, `todowrite`) и `tool_choice: auto`, а ответы с `tool_calls` исполняются локальным исполнителем инструментов.

Now task 4: the navigator's absolute numbering.

Root cause (confirmed): the chat loads the last 20 messages (`MessageHistoryPaginationLogic.initialLimit = 20`), and `UserMessageNavigator` numbers only the user messages inside the loaded window → in the user's chat (24 messages, 12 user messages) the last visible user message is #10 ✓.

Fix: number the navigator entries by their absolute position among the session's user messages.

Implementation:
1. `DatabaseBridge.userMessageCount(sessionId:)` → the total number of user messages in the session ✓ (project DB + global DB).
2. `MessageStore`: track `olderUserMessageCount` — the number of user messages that precede the loaded window ✓.
   - On the initial tail load: `older = totalUserMessages - userMessagesInLoadedWindow`.
   - When older pages are loaded: `older -= userMessagesInPage`.
3. `UserMessageNavigator`: take an `offset: Int` and number `offset + index + 1` ✓.

Hmm, the counting rule must match the navigator's filter (user + non-empty preview). Let me define a shared rule:
- The navigator lists user messages whose preview is non-empty.
- The DB count: `role = 'user' AND length(trim(content)) > 0` — a user message with only files has empty content in the DB but a non-empty preview (file names) ✗ mismatch (rare).

To keep them consistent, let me make the navigator's list rule = "user messages with non-empty content OR with files" (the current preview rule ✓) and the DB count rule = "user messages with non-empty trimmed content". A file-only user message would be counted by the navigator but not by the DB → the offset would be off by one for chats with file-only user messages ✗.

Hmm. Alternative: make the DB count = role='user' (ALL user messages) and the navigator's list = all user messages (drop the preview filter) — then the numbering is exact ✓ and the only downside: a whitespace-only user message would show as an empty numbered button. Hmm.

Hmm, what about the preview filter's purpose? It skips user messages with no visible content (e.g. an empty send) ✓. An empty button in the navigator would be odd but harmless.

Hmm, let me think about which is less surprising for the user: the user wants the numbers to reflect the whole chat ✓. A gap in the numbering (due to file-only messages) is a minor cosmetic issue; an empty button is also minor.

Decision: keep the navigator's list = user messages with a non-empty preview (unchanged behavior ✓), and compute the absolute index using the DB's count of user messages WITH content (the dominant rule) — hmm, but then for chats with file-only user messages the numbers would skip ✗.

Hmm, alternatively: compute the offset from the DB using the SAME rule as the navigator by counting user messages whose content is non-empty OR that have a non-text part (a file/image part) ✓. The parts types in the DB: "text", "tool_call", "image"? Let me check what part types exist for a user message with an attached image: the ImageChatViews/ClipboardImage → probably stored as an "image" part ✓.

Let me check the part types written by DatabaseBridge.saveMessage ✓ (line ~475: "Persist every part (text, reasoning, tool_call, steps, images)") → types: text, reasoning, tool_call, step, image ✓.

So the DB rule for a navigator-visible user message: `role='user' AND (length(trim(content)) > 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM message_parts WHERE message_id = messages.id AND type IN ('image','file')))`.

Hmm, "file" doesn't exist as a type; files are probably embedded in the content? Let me check how an attached file is persisted: `message.files` isn't persisted (per the earlier grep ✗) → a user message with only files would have empty content and no parts → invisible in the DB count but visible in the navigator ✗ (a 1-off).

OK, let me simplify and make the rule IDENTICAL everywhere by dropping the file fallback from the navigator's list rule... hmm, that changes the navigator's behavior (a file-only user message wouldn't be navigable ✗ hmm).

You know what? Let me look at this from a different angle: the navigator's absolute numbering can be computed WITHOUT the DB count if the MessageStore knows the total number of user messages in the session ✓ (a DB count) AND the number of user messages before the loaded window ✓ (also a DB count with a "before" predicate).

Both counts use the same DB rule ✓ → their difference is consistent ✓. The only mismatch is between the DB rule and the navigator's in-memory filter (file-only messages). To eliminate it: make the navigator's filter ALSO use the DB rule (content non-empty) — i.e. drop the files fallback in the navigator's LIST (but keep the files fallback in the PREVIEW for messages that do have content? no...).

Hmm, let me look at the actual preview function: `preview(for:)` = normalized(content) or, if empty, the file names ✓. If I keep this, a file-only message has a preview ✓ → it's in the list ✓.

where the in-memory count uses the same "content non-empty" rule ✓ (not the preview rule) → then the navigator's list (which may include file-only messages) is numbered with an index into a DIFFERENT sequence → gaps ✗ (rare).

OK, final decision (pragmatic, exact for the common case): make BOTH the counts and the navigator use the "preview non-empty" rule, and make the DB count rule = `role='user' AND (length(trim(content)) > 0 OR EXISTS(parts with type='image'))` — covering images ✓; file-only messages (which aren't persisted at all) remain a rare edge case ✗.

Simplest: exclude file-only messages from the list (content rule) ✓ → no duplicates ✓ → exact numbers ✓.

If a user message has only attachments → the content is empty but the message is persisted with an empty content ✗ (and the attachments are lost on reload ✓).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Split a unified diff into per-file hunks and keep only the hunks whose
body does not match the exclusion regex. Used to stage one feature at a time."""
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

path = sys.argv[1]
exclude = sys.argv[2]
pattern = re.compile(exclude)

diff = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "diff", "-U3", "--", path],
    check=True,
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
).stdout

lines = diff.splitlines(keepends=True)
header: list[str] = []
hunks: list[list[str]] = []
current: list[str] | None = None
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith("@@"):
        current = [line]
        hunks.append(current)
    elif current is None:
        header.append(line)
    else:
        current.append(line)

kept = [hunk for hunk in hunks if not pattern.search("".join(hunk))]
dropped = len(hunks) - len(kept)
if dropped == 0:
    sys.stderr.write("no hunk matched the exclusion pattern\n")
    sys.exit(2)

out = "".join(header) + "".join("".join(hunk) for hunk in kept)
target = Path(sys.argv[3])
target.write_text(out)
print(f"kept {len(kept)} of {len(hunks)} hunks -> {target}")

            ;;
        --parallel)
            PARALLEL=1
            shift
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Unknown option: $1"
            exit 2
            ;;
    esac
done

# ── Platform/toolchain preflight ─────────────────────────────
if [ "$(uname -s)" != "Darwin" ]; then
    echo "━━━ ❌ myCoder build requires macOS (SwiftUI/AppKit/WebKit)."
    echo "━━━    Current platform: $(uname -s). Run this script on a macOS runner."
    exit 3
fi
if [ ! -x /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy ] || ! command -v swift >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v xcodebuild >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "━━━ ❌ myCoder build requires Xcode command-line tools and Swift on macOS."
    echo "━━━    Install/select Xcode, then re-run ./build-app.sh."
    exit 3
fi

# ── Version metadata ─────────────────────────────────────────
SHORT_VER=$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Print :CFBundleShortVersionString" "$INFO_PLIST" 2>/dev/null || echo "0.1.0")
BUILD_NUM=$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Print :CFBundleVersion" "$INFO_PLIST" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
echo "━━━ Current: v$SHORT_VER (build $BUILD_NUM)"

# Normalize and bump one semantic version component only when explicitly asked.
version_parts=(${SHORT_VER//./ })
MAJOR="${version_parts[0]:-0}"
MINOR="${version_parts[1]:-0}"
PATCH="${version_parts[2]:-0}"
if ! [[ "$MAJOR" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$MINOR" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$PATCH" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    echo "━━━ ❌ Invalid semantic version in $INFO_PLIST: $SHORT_VER"
    exit 2
fi
if ! [[ "$BUILD_NUM" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    echo "━━━ ❌ Invalid numeric build number in $INFO_PLIST: $BUILD_NUM"
    exit 2
fi

if [ -n "$BUMP_KIND" ]; then
    case "$BUMP_KIND" in
        major) NEW_SHORT="$((MAJOR + 1)).0.0" ;;
        minor) NEW_SHORT="${MAJOR}.$((MINOR + 1)).0" ;;
        patch) NEW_SHORT="${MAJOR}.${MINOR}.$((PATCH + 1))" ;;
    esac
    NEW_BUILD=$((BUILD_NUM + 1))
    echo "━━━ Release bump ($BUMP_KIND): v$SHORT_VER → v$NEW_SHORT; build $BUILD_NUM → $NEW_BUILD"
    /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Set :CFBundleShortVersionString $NEW_SHORT" "$INFO_PLIST"
    /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Set :CFBundleVersion $NEW_BUILD" "$INFO_PLIST"
else
    NEW_SHORT="$SHORT_VER"
    NEW_BUILD="$BUILD_NUM"
    echo "━━━ No version bump (use --bump [patch|minor|major] for a release)"
fi

# ── Tests (optional — never block a build check) ─────────────
if [ "$SKIP_TESTS" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "━━━ Skipping tests (--skip-tests)"
else
    echo "━━━ Running tests… (failures are reported but do NOT abort the build)"
    if swift test; then
        echo "━━━ Tests passed."
    else
        echo "━━━ ⚠️  Tests failed — continuing to build anyway (see output above)."
    fi
fi

# ── Build release ────────────────────────────────────────────
echo "━━━ Building release…"
if [ "$PARALLEL" -eq 1 ]; then
    CORES=$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null || echo 8)
    BUILD_ARGS="--jobs $CORES"
    OPT_FLAG="-O"
    echo "    (parallel: $CORES jobs, -O optimization)"
else
    BUILD_ARGS="--jobs 1"
    OPT_FLAG="-Onone"
    echo "    (single-thread, -Onone — avoids Swift 6.3 deadlock)"
fi

if ! swift build -c release --product "$APP_NAME" $BUILD_ARGS -Xswiftc -no-whole-module-optimization -Xswiftc "$OPT_FLAG"; then
    echo ""
    echo "━━━ ❌ BUILD FAILED. Full compiler output is above (not truncated)."
    echo "━━━    Fix the errors and re-run ./build-app.sh"
    exit 1
fi

# ── Assemble the .app bundle in the repo root ────────────────
echo "━━━ Assembling $APP_BUNDLE (clean)…"
rm -rf "$APP_BUNDLE"
mkdir -p "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/MacOS" "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/Resources"

cp "$BUILD_DIR/$APP_NAME" "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/MacOS/$APP_NAME"
chmod +x "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/MacOS/$APP_NAME"
cp "$INFO_PLIST" "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/Info.plist"
if [ -f "$RESOURCES_DIR/AppIcon.icns" ]; then
    cp "$RESOURCES_DIR/AppIcon.icns" "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/Resources/AppIcon.icns"
fi

echo "━━━ Copying resource bundles…"
shopt -s nullglob
copied=0
for b in "$BUILD_DIR"/*.bundle; do
    cp -R "$b" "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/Resources/"
    echo "    + $(basename "$b")"
    copied=$((copied + 1))
done
shopt -u nullglob
if [ "$copied" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "    (no SPM resource bundles found — catalogs may not load)"
fi

# ── Code signing ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# A fresh unsigned bundle triggers Gatekeeper/XProtect on every launch.
# Use an explicit identity via CODESIGN_IDENTITY, otherwise prefer a local
# Apple Development identity, then fall back to ad-hoc signing.
SIGN_IDENTITY="${CODESIGN_IDENTITY:-}"
if [ -z "$SIGN_IDENTITY" ]; then
    SIGN_IDENTITY=$(security find-identity -v -p codesigning 2>/dev/null \
        | awk -F'"' '/Apple Development:/{print $2; exit}')
fi
if [ -z "$SIGN_IDENTITY" ]; then
    SIGN_IDENTITY=$(security find-identity -v -p codesigning 2>/dev/null \
        | awk -F'"' '/Developer ID Application:/{print $2; exit}')
fi
if [ -n "$SIGN_IDENTITY" ]; then
    echo "━━━ Signing with: $SIGN_IDENTITY"
    if ! codesign --force --deep --sign "$SIGN_IDENTITY" "$APP_BUNDLE"; then
        echo "━━━ ⚠️  Signing failed — leaving the bundle unsigned"
    elif codesign --verify --deep --strict "$APP_BUNDLE"; then
        echo "━━━ ✅ Signature verified"
    else
        echo "━━━ ⚠️  Signature verification failed"
    fi
else
    echo "━━━ ⚠️  No code-signing identity found; macOS may re-check the app on launch"
fi

BIN_SIZE=$(stat -f "%z" "$BUILD_DIR/$APP_NAME" 2>/dev/null || stat --format="%s" "$BUILD_DIR/$APP_NAME" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
echo "━━━ ✅ Built v$NEW_SHORT (build $NEW_BUILD) — $((BIN_SIZE / 1024)) KB"
echo "━━━ App: $SCRIPT_DIR/$APP_BUNDLE"
echo "━━━ Run: open '$APP_BUNDLE'"

+import Foundation
+
+/// Handling of a tool call whose path lies outside the project folder.
+///
+/// The host must not dead-end such a call with a bare validation error: the
+/// user is asked for access to that folder, and an approved grant lets the
+/// call run. The model never decides on its own that a path is off-limits —
+/// it emits the tool call and the host decides.
+enum OutOfProjectAccessLogic {
+    /// Folder that covers the requested path: the path itself when it is a
+    /// directory, its parent folder otherwise.
+    static func grantRoot(
+        forPath path: String,
+        fileManager: FileManager = .default
+    ) -> String {
+        let absolute = path.hasPrefix("/")
+            ? path
+            : FileManager.default.currentDirectoryPath + "/" + path
+        let standardized = (absolute as NSString).standardizingPath
+        var isDirectory: ObjCBool = false
+        if fileManager.fileExists(atPath: standardized, isDirectory: &isDirectory), isDirectory.boolValue {
+            return standardized
+        }
+        return (standardized as NSString).deletingLastPathComponent
+    }
+
+    /// True when the path lies inside the project folder or inside one of the
+    /// folders the user granted access to.
+    static func isAccessible(
+        path: String,
+        projectRoot: String,
+        grantedRoots: [String] = [],
+        fileManager: FileManager = .default
+    ) -> Bool {
+        if WebToolProtocolEmulator.isPathInsideRoot(path, root: projectRoot) {
+            return true
+        }
+        guard path.hasPrefix("/") else { return false }
+        return grantedRoots.contains { WebToolProtocolEmulator.isPathInsideRoot(path, root: $0) }
+    }
+
+    /// Approval card shown to the user.
+    static func approvalMessage(tool: String, path: String, projectRoot: String) -> String {
+        "The agent asked to use \(tool) on \(path), which is outside the project folder \(projectRoot). Allow access to that folder?"
+    }
+
+    /// Result fed back to the model when the user refuses the access.
+    static func denialMessage(tool: String, path: String) -> String {
+        "the user denied access to \(path) (outside the project folder), so \(tool) was not executed. Do not retry the same path; ask the user how to proceed."
+    }
+
+    /// Result fed back to the model when the path is still out of reach after
+    /// the grant (for example a path the grant does not cover).
+    static func validationMessage(path: String) -> String {
+        "validation error: pathEscapesProject(\(path)) — the folder is outside the project and the user did not grant access to it."
+    }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+import Foundation
+
+/// The "no project" mode: a chat that is not attached to a project folder.
+///
+/// Such a chat still needs a real working directory — otherwise every tool
+/// call resolves relative paths against a non-existent folder and shell
+/// commands run from an arbitrary place. The home folder is used instead: the
+/// chat can work with files, and anything outside the chat's own folder is
+/// handled by the out-of-project access request.
+enum ProjectlessWorkspaceLogic {
+    static var workspaceID: String { ChatSession.standaloneProjectKey }
+
+    /// Working directory of a project-less chat.
+    static func workingDirectory(
+        homeDirectory: String = FileManager.default.homeDirectoryForCurrentUser.path
+    ) -> String {
+        homeDirectory
+    }
+
+    /// True when the given workspace is the synthetic project-less workspace.
+    static func isProjectless(_ workspace: Workspace?) -> Bool {
+        workspace?.id == workspaceID
+    }
+
+    /// Working directory of the open chat.
+    ///
+    /// A project chat uses its project folder. A project-less chat uses the
+    /// home folder even while a project is selected in the sidebar — the open
+    /// chat decides, not the sidebar selection.
+    static func workingDirectory(
+        sessionDirectory: String?,
+        workspacePath: String?,
+        homeDirectory: String = FileManager.default.homeDirectoryForCurrentUser.path
+    ) -> String {
+        if let sessionDirectory, !sessionDirectory.isEmpty {
+            return sessionDirectory == workspaceID ? homeDirectory : sessionDirectory
+        }
+        if let workspacePath, !workspacePath.isEmpty, workspacePath != workspaceID {
+            return workspacePath
+        }
+        return homeDirectory
+    }
+}

+import Testing

+/// The "no project" mode: a chat that is not tied to a project folder must
+/// still have a real working directory, so tools and shell commands work.
+@Suite("No-project mode")
+struct ProjectlessWorkspaceTests {
+
+    @Test("A project chat uses its project folder")
+    func projectChatUsesProjectFolder() {
+        let root = ProjectlessWorkspaceLogic.workingDirectory(
+            sessionDirectory: "/Users/apple/projects/demo",
+            workspacePath: "/Users/apple/projects/demo",
+            homeDirectory: "/Users/apple"
+        )
+        #expect(root == "/Users/apple/projects/demo")
+    }
+
+    @Test("A project-less chat uses the home folder")
+    func projectlessChatUsesHomeFolder() {
+        let root = ProjectlessWorkspaceLogic.workingDirectory(
+            sessionDirectory: ChatSession.standaloneProjectKey,
+            workspacePath: ChatSession.standaloneProjectKey,
+            homeDirectory: "/Users/apple"
+        )
+        #expect(root == "/Users/apple")
+    }
+
+    @Test("An open project-less chat keeps the home folder while a project is selected")
+    func projectlessChatWinsOverSelectedProject() {
+        let root = ProjectlessWorkspaceLogic.workingDirectory(
+            sessionDirectory: ChatSession.standaloneProjectKey,
+            workspacePath: "/Users/apple/projects/demo",
+            homeDirectory: "/Users/apple"
+        )
+        #expect(root == "/Users/apple")
+    }
+
+    @Test("Without a chat the selected project is used")
+    func noChatUsesSelectedProject() {
+        let root = ProjectlessWorkspaceLogic.workingDirectory(
+            sessionDirectory: nil,
+            workspacePath: "/Users/apple/projects/demo",
+            homeDirectory: "/Users/apple"
+        )
+        #expect(root == "/Users/apple/projects/demo")
+    }
+
+    @Test("Without a chat and without a project the home folder is used")
+    func noChatNoProjectUsesHomeFolder() {
+        let root = ProjectlessWorkspaceLogic.workingDirectory(
+            sessionDirectory: nil,
+            workspacePath: nil,
+            homeDirectory: "/Users/apple"
+        )
+        #expect(root == "/Users/apple")
+    }
+
+    @Test("The synthetic workspace is recognized as project-less")
+    func recognizesProjectlessWorkspace() {
+        #expect(ProjectlessWorkspaceLogic.isProjectless(nil) == false)
+        #expect(ProjectlessWorkspaceLogic.isProjectless(
+            Workspace(id: "p1", name: "Demo", path: "/tmp/demo", tasks: [])
+        ) == false)
+        #expect(ProjectlessWorkspaceLogic.isProjectless(
+            Workspace(id: ChatSession.standaloneProjectKey, name: "Chats", path: ChatSession.standaloneProjectKey, tasks: [])
+        ) == true)
+    }
+
+    @MainActor
+    @Test("Selecting the no-project mode switches the working directory to the home folder")

251:     /// prose and markdown fences (plan Блок 2 п.11/п.13), and — since Round 12 —
252:     /// also of the informal `[tool call: NAME with args]` syntax that plain web
253:     /// models actually emit (e.g. `[tool call: LS with path "."]`), so the
254:     /// agentic loop never stalls on a well-meant but non-strict call.
255:     static func parseToolCalls(from responseText: String) -> [WebToolCall] {
256:         var calls: [WebToolCall] = []
257:         // Find ```tool ... ``` fenced blocks. The closing fence may directly
258:         // follow the JSON (no trailing newline) — tolerate that too.
259:         let scanner = responseText as NSString
260:         let pattern = "```tool\\s*\\n(.*?)\\s*```"
261:         if let regex = try? NSRegularExpression(pattern: pattern, options: [.dotMatchesLineSeparators]) {
262:             let matches = regex.matches(in: responseText, range: NSRange(location: 0, length: scanner.length))
263:             for match in matches where match.numberOfRanges >= 2 {
264:                 let jsonString = scanner.substring(with: match.range(at: 1))
265:                 if let call = parseSingleCall(jsonString) {
266:                     calls.append(call)
267:                 }
268:             }
269:         }
270:         // Then the informal `[tool call: NAME ...]` variant.
271:         calls.append(contentsOf: parseInformalCalls(from: responseText))
272:         // Then the XML `<NAME>k=v</NAME>` variant that big-pickle / MiMo-style models emit natively.
273:         calls.append(contentsOf: parseTaggedToolCalls(from: responseText))
274:         // Then the SHORT XML form the preamble itself teaches:
275:         // `<list_dir>path=.</list_dir>` (audit 2026-09-11, Kimi live: the
276:         // model emits exactly this, the verbose parser ignores it, and the
277:         // turn dies with raw tool text as the "answer").
278:         calls.append(contentsOf: parseShortTaggedCalls(from: responseText))
279: 
280:         // Audit 2026-09-08 (Qwen live): reasoning streams can BREAK the fence
281:         // itself — the answer arrives as `tool\n1\n{"name":\u{00A0}"list_dir", ...}`
282:         // with no backticks at all. Scan for complete {"name": …, "args": {…}}
283:         // objects in the raw text (NBSP-normalized) before the truncated-stub
284:         // fallback, so a fully written call without fences still executes.
285:         if calls.isEmpty {
286:             calls.append(contentsOf: parseUnfencedJSONToolCalls(from: responseText))
287:         }
288: 
289: 
290:         // Audit 2026-09-08 (Qwen live): models sometimes emit a tool call the
291:         // STREAM CUT OFF mid-JSON — `call {"name": "list_dir", "arguments` —
292:         // no fence, no closing brace. Such a response is NOT a final answer;
293:         // recover the tool name and keep the loop alive so the driver can
294:         // feed back "incomplete call, re-emit" instead of showing the stub.
295:         // Only when no complete call parsed — the stub detector is a fallback,
296:         // never a second opinion on a well-formed call.
297:         if calls.isEmpty {
298:             calls.append(contentsOf: parseTruncatedToolCallStub(from: responseText))
299:         }
300:         return calls
301:     }

303:     /// Detect a stream-truncated tool call: a known tool name followed by an
304:     /// UNTERMINATED JSON body (no closing `}` after the name, no fence). The
305:     /// recovered call carries whatever arguments are readable plus a marker so
306:     /// validation reports it as incomplete rather than executing blindly.
307:     /// Live (Qwen 2026-09-08): reasoning streams also die mid-XML, mangling
308:     /// the tags into `⟨path⟩ ⟨arg_value⟩` — a bare known-tool mention near
309:     /// half-written argument tags is detected the same way.
310:     static func parseTruncatedToolCallStub(from text: String) -> [WebToolCall] {
311:         // JSON form: `{"name": "tool", ...` with no closing brace.
312:         let pattern = "\\{\\s*\"name\"\\s*:\\s*\"([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*)\""
313:         if let regex = try? NSRegularExpression(pattern: pattern) {
314:             let scanner = text as NSString
315:             var calls: [WebToolCall] = []
316:             for match in regex.matches(in: text, range: NSRange(location: 0, length: scanner.length)) where match.numberOfRanges >= 2 {
317:                 let name = scanner.substring(with: match.range(at: 1))
318:                 guard let canonical = canonicalToolName(name) else { continue }
319:                 let rest = scanner.substring(from: match.range(at: 1).location + match.range(at: 1).length)
320:                 if rest.contains("}") { continue }
321:                 var args = truncatedCallArguments(from: rest)
322:                 args["__micoder_truncated"] = "1"
323:                 calls.append(WebToolCall(name: canonical, arguments: args))
324:             }
325:             if !calls.isEmpty { return calls }
326:         }
327:         // Mangled/truncated XML form: the tool name followed by half-written
328:         // argument tags (⟨arg⟩ / ⟨/arg_value⟩ / <arg without close) — the
329:         // complete tagged parser already handles well-formed XML.
330:         for (canonical, raw) in WebEmulatedTool.allCases.map({ (canonicalToolName($0.rawValue)!, $0.rawValue) }) {
331:             guard let range = text.range(of: raw) else { continue }
332:             let after = String(text[range.upperBound...])
333:             // A well-formed tagged body after the mention parses upstream —
334:             // never touch those. Vendors also mangle angle brackets into
335:             // unicode look-alikes, so accept both ASCII and mangled closers.
336:             if after.contains("</\(raw)>") || after.contains("⟩/\(raw)⟩") { continue }
337:             // Truncated/mangled argument region right after the tool mention:
338:             // half-written or unicode-mangled angle tags. A CLOSING tag of the
339:             // tool right after the mention (any bracket flavor) means the
340:             // tagged parser already handled the full body — skip.
341:             if after.hasPrefix(">") || after.hasPrefix("⟩") { continue }
342:             // A closed </tool_name> right after the mention means the NAME
343:             // arrived complete — but the ARGUMENT region may still be a
344:             // mangled truncation (live: "⟨path⟩ ⟨arg_value⟩ ." with real
345:             // <arg_key>/<arg_value> tags never appearing). Only skip when
346:             // real ASCII argument tags exist AND no mangled ones.
347:             if after.hasPrefix("</tool_name>") || after.hasPrefix("⟩/tool_name⟩") {
348:                 let argRegion = String(after[after.index(after.startIndex, offsetBy: min(after.count, 13))...])
349:                 let opensRealTag = argRegion.contains("<arg_key") || argRegion.contains("<arg_value") || argRegion.contains("<path")
350:                 let opensMangledTag = argRegion.contains("⟨arg") || argRegion.contains("⟨path")
351:                 if opensMangledTag {
352:                     var args = truncatedCallArguments(from: argRegion)
353:                     args["__micoder_truncated"] = "1"
354:                     return [WebToolCall(name: canonical, arguments: args)]
355:                 }
356:                 if opensRealTag { continue }
357:                 // Audit 2026-09-09 (test regression): a COMPLETE well-formed
358:                 // XML body whose angle brackets the vendor mangles into ⟨…⟩
359:                 // ("⟨pattern⟩x⟨/pattern⟩") contains argument-shaped tags but
360:                 // no truncation — a generic "any ⟨ counts" check fired a fake
361:                 // truncated stub and blocked the call. Only half-written
362:                 // argument tags (⟨arg…, ⟨path…, <arg without closer, or an
363:                 // unterminated ⟨ value) mark a real cut stream.
364:                 let hasHalfWrittenArg = argRegion.contains("⟨arg") || argRegion.contains("⟨path")
365:                     || (argRegion.contains("<arg") && !argRegion.contains(">arg"))
366:                     || (argRegion.contains("⟨") && !argRegion.contains("⟩"))
367:                 if hasHalfWrittenArg {
368:                     var args = truncatedCallArguments(from: argRegion)
369:                     args["__micoder_truncated"] = "1"
370:                     return [WebToolCall(name: canonical, arguments: args)]
371:                 }
372:                 continue
373:             }
374:             if after.contains("⟨") || after.contains("<arg") || after.contains("</tool") {
375:                 var args = truncatedCallArguments(from: after)
376:                 args["__micoder_truncated"] = "1"
377:                 return [WebToolCall(name: canonical, arguments: args)]
378:             }
379:         }
380:         // Truncated `<tool_name>NAME` prefix (Qwen live: the stream died
381:         // INSIDE the tool name itself — "<tool_name>list" — leaving a known
382:         // tool prefix with no closing bracket at all). Recover it as a stub
383:         // so the driver asks the model to re-emit the complete call.
384:         if let nameRange = text.range(of: "<tool_name>") ?? text.range(of: "⟨tool_name⟩") {
385:             let candidate = String(text[nameRange.upperBound...])
386:                 .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
387:             for (canonical, raw) in WebEmulatedTool.allCases.map({ (canonicalToolName($0.rawValue)!, $0.rawValue) }) {
388:                 if candidate.hasPrefix(raw) { continue }   // full name → handled above
389:                 if raw.hasPrefix(candidate), !candidate.isEmpty {
390:                     return [WebToolCall(name: canonical, arguments: ["__micoder_truncated": "1"])]
391:                 }
392:             }
393:         }
394:         return []
395:     }

397:     /// Best-effort argument extraction from a truncated JSON body: any
398:     /// `"key": "value` pairs, even when the closing quote/brace was lost.
399:     private static func truncatedCallArguments(from body: String) -> [String: String] {
400:         var args: [String: String] = [:]
401:         let pattern = "\"([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*)\"\\s*:\\s*\"?([^\",}]*)"
402:         guard let regex = try? NSRegularExpression(pattern: pattern) else { return args }
403:         let scanner = body as NSString
404:         for match in regex.matches(in: body, range: NSRange(location: 0, length: scanner.length)) where match.numberOfRanges >= 3 {
405:             if let k = substring(in: match, at: 1, of: scanner),
406:                let v = substring(in: match, at: 2, of: scanner) {
407:                 let key = k.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
408:                 if !key.isEmpty { args[key] = v.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines) }
409:             }
410:         }
411:         return args
412:     }

414:     /// Parse the XML tool-call format that big-pickle / MiMo-style models emit:
415:     /// `<tool_call>execute_command<arg_key>command</arg_key><arg_value>pwd</arg_value></tool_call>`.
416:     /// Live models pretty-print the block across lines (newline after the name,
417:     /// between arg tags, and before </tool_call>), so every boundary tolerates
418:     /// whitespace — otherwise the calls are silently dropped and the agentic
419:     /// loop stalls showing raw unexecuted tool calls.
420:     private static func parseTaggedToolCalls(from text: String) -> [WebToolCall] {
421:         let scanner = text as NSString
422:         let pattern = "<tool_call>\\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*)((?:\\s*<arg_key>[\\s\\S]*?</arg_key>\\s*<arg_value>[\\s\\S]*?</arg_value>)*)\\s*</tool_call>"
423:         guard let regex = try? NSRegularExpression(pattern: pattern) else { return [] }
424:         var calls: [WebToolCall] = []
425:         for match in regex.matches(in: text, range: NSRange(location: 0, length: scanner.length)) where match.numberOfRanges >= 3 {
426:             let name = scanner.substring(with: match.range(at: 1))
427:             guard let canonical = canonicalToolName(name) else { continue }
428:             let pairsBody = scanner.substring(with: match.range(at: 2))
429:             let argPattern = "<arg_key>([\\s\\S]*?)</arg_key>\\s*<arg_value>([\\s\\S]*?)</arg_value>"
430:             var args: [String: String] = [:]
431:             if let pairRegex = try? NSRegularExpression(pattern: argPattern) {
432:                 let body = pairsBody as NSString
433:                 for pm in pairRegex.matches(in: pairsBody, range: NSRange(location: 0, length: body.length)) where pm.numberOfRanges >= 3 {
434:                     if let k = substring(in: pm, at: 1, of: body),
435:                        let v = substring(in: pm, at: 2, of: body) {
436:                         args[k.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)] = v
437:                     }
438:                 }
439:             }
440:             calls.append(WebToolCall(name: canonical, arguments: args))
441:         }
442:         return calls
443:     }

445:     /// Parse the SHORT XML form taught by the system preamble:
446:     /// `<list_dir>path=.</list_dir>`. Tag name must be a known tool (this
447:     /// rejects arbitrary HTML), args are `key=value` pairs separated by
448:     /// whitespace with optionally quoted values.
449:     private static func parseShortTaggedCalls(from text: String) -> [WebToolCall] {
450:         let scanner = text as NSString
451:         let pattern = "<([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*)>([^<>]*)</\\1>"
452:         guard let regex = try? NSRegularExpression(pattern: pattern, options: [.dotMatchesLineSeparators]) else { return [] }
453:         var calls: [WebToolCall] = []
454:         for match in regex.matches(in: text, range: NSRange(location: 0, length: scanner.length)) where match.numberOfRanges >= 3 {
455:             let name = scanner.substring(with: match.range(at: 1))
456:             guard let canonical = canonicalToolName(name) else { continue }
457:             let body = scanner.substring(with: match.range(at: 2))
458:             calls.append(WebToolCall(name: canonical, arguments: parseShortTagArgs(body)))
459:         }
460:         return calls
461:     }
462: 
463:     /// Parse `k=v` pairs: `path=.`, `path="my dir"`, `limit=5`.
464:     private static func parseShortTagArgs(_ text: String) -> [String: String] {
465:         var args: [String: String] = [:]
466:         let scanner = text as NSString
467:         let pattern = "([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*)\\s*=\\s*(\"([^\"]*)\"|'([^']*)'|(\\S+))"
468:         guard let regex = try? NSRegularExpression(pattern: pattern) else { return args }
469:         for m in regex.matches(in: text, range: NSRange(location: 0, length: scanner.length)) where m.numberOfRanges >= 6 {
470:             guard let key = substring(in: m, at: 1, of: scanner) else { continue }
471:             let value = substring(in: m, at: 3, of: scanner)
472:                 ?? substring(in: m, at: 4, of: scanner)
473:                 ?? substring(in: m, at: 5, of: scanner)
474:                 ?? ""
475:             args[key.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)] = value
476:         }
477:         return args
478:     }

480:     /// Parse `[tool call: NAME with key value / key="value" ...]`.
481:     private static func parseInformalCalls(from text: String) -> [WebToolCall] {
482:         let scanner = text as NSString
483:         let pattern = "\\[tool call:\\s*([^\\]]+)\\]"
484:         guard let regex = try? NSRegularExpression(pattern: pattern, options: [.dotMatchesLineSeparators]) else {
485:             return []
486:         }
487:         var calls: [WebToolCall] = []
488:         let matches = regex.matches(in: text, range: NSRange(location: 0, length: scanner.length))
489:         for match in matches where match.numberOfRanges >= 2 {
490:             let body = scanner.substring(with: match.range(at: 1)).trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
491:             let tokens = body.split(separator: " ", maxSplits: 1).map(String.init)
492:             guard let rawName = tokens.first, let name = canonicalToolName(rawName) else { continue }
493:             var argsText = tokens.count > 1 ? tokens[1] : ""
494:             // Drop the connective "with": "[tool call: LS with path "."]" →
495:             // args "path \".\"".
496:             let withPrefix = argsText.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
497:             if withPrefix.hasPrefix("with ") {
498:                 argsText = String(withPrefix.dropFirst(5))
499:             }
500:             calls.append(WebToolCall(name: name, arguments: parseInformalArgs(argsText)))
501:         }
502:         return calls
503:     }
504: 
505:     /// Parse `path "."` / `path="."` / `path='.'` / `path=.` / `pattern "x"`
506:     /// into [String: String]. Bare `key value` (space-separated, unquoted)
507:     /// stays unsupported — too ambiguous with paths containing spaces.
508:     private static func parseInformalArgs(_ text: String) -> [String: String] {
509:         var args: [String: String] = [:]
510:         let scanner = text as NSString
511:         // k="v" OR k "v" OR k='v' OR k=v. Alternation groups: the branch
512:         // that did NOT match has NSNotFound ranges — guard before substring.
513:         let key = "([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)"
514:         let quoted = key + "\\s*=\\s*\"([^\"]*)\""       // groups 1,2
515:             + "|" + key + "\\s+\"([^\"]*)\""             // groups 3,4
516:             + "|" + key + "\\s*=\\s*'([^']*)'"           // groups 5,6
517:             + "|" + key + "\\s*=\\s*(\\S+)"              // groups 7,8
518:         guard let regex = try? NSRegularExpression(pattern: quoted) else { return args }
519:         let matches = regex.matches(in: text, range: NSRange(location: 0, length: scanner.length))
520:         for m in matches where m.numberOfRanges >= 9 {
521:             if let key = substring(in: m, at: 1, of: scanner),
522:                let value = substring(in: m, at: 2, of: scanner) {
523:                 args[key] = value
524:             } else if let key = substring(in: m, at: 3, of: scanner),
525:                       let value = substring(in: m, at: 4, of: scanner) {
526:                 args[key] = value
527:             } else if let key = substring(in: m, at: 5, of: scanner),
528:                       let value = substring(in: m, at: 6, of: scanner) {
529:                 args[key] = value
530:             } else if let key = substring(in: m, at: 7, of: scanner),
531:                       let value = substring(in: m, at: 8, of: scanner) {
532:                 args[key] = value
533:             }
534:         }
535:         return args
536:     }

538:     /// Safe group extraction: returns nil for NSNotFound so the alternation
539:     /// branches of an NSRegularExpression never crash `substring(with:)`.
540:     private static func substring(in match: NSTextCheckingResult, at index: Int,
541:                                   of scanner: NSString) -> String? {
542:         let range = match.range(at: index)
543:         guard range.location != NSNotFound, range.length > 0 else { return nil }
544:         return scanner.substring(with: range)
545:     }

547:     /// Map a model's informal tool spelling to the canonical tool name.
548:     /// Web models write "LS"/"ls" for list_dir, "Read" for read_file, etc.
549:     /// Unknown names → nil so they surface as `.unknownTool` validation errors
550:     /// instead of being silently dropped.
551:     ///
552:     /// Normalization (applied before matching): trim, lowercase, "-" → "_".
553:     /// This covers Anthropic PascalCase (Read/Edit/Write/Bash/Glob/Grep/Task/
554:     /// TodoWrite/WebFetch/Skill/TaskCreate/...), snake_case, and hyphenated
555:     /// spellings (git-commit, read-file) with one rule instead of N entries.
556:     static func canonicalToolName(_ name: String) -> String? {
557:         let lower = name.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
558:             .lowercased()
559:             .replacingOccurrences(of: "-", with: "_")
560:         switch lower {
561:         case "ls", "list_dir", "list", "dir", "directory", "ls_dir":
562:             return WebEmulatedTool.listDir.rawValue
563:         case "read_file", "read", "cat", "view":
564:             return WebEmulatedTool.readFile.rawValue
565:         case "write_file", "write", "create", "create_file":
566:             return WebEmulatedTool.writeFile.rawValue
567:         case "edit_file", "edit", "replace", "apply_patch", "str_replace":
568:             return WebEmulatedTool.editFile.rawValue
569:         case "grep", "search", "find", "rg", "ripgrep":
570:             return WebEmulatedTool.grep.rawValue
571:         case "run_command", "run", "execute", "execute_command", "shell",
572:              "sh", "bash", "cmd":
573:             return WebEmulatedTool.runCommand.rawValue
574:         // Git operations
575:         case "git_status", "status", "gs":
576:             return WebEmulatedTool.gitStatus.rawValue
577:         case "git_diff", "diff", "gd":
578:             return WebEmulatedTool.gitDiff.rawValue
579:         case "git_log", "log":
580:             return WebEmulatedTool.gitLog.rawValue
581:         case "git_branch", "branch", "gb":
582:             return WebEmulatedTool.gitBranch.rawValue
583:         case "git_checkout", "checkout", "co", "gco":
584:             return WebEmulatedTool.gitCheckout.rawValue
585:         case "git_commit", "commit", "gc":
586:             return WebEmulatedTool.gitCommit.rawValue
587:         case "git_push", "push", "gp":
588:             return WebEmulatedTool.gitPush.rawValue
589:         case "git_pull", "pull", "gl":
590:             return WebEmulatedTool.gitPull.rawValue
591:         // File search & glob
592:         case "glob", "glob_search", "find_files":
593:             return WebEmulatedTool.glob.rawValue
594:         case "todo_read", "todos", "todo", "todoread":
595:             return WebEmulatedTool.todoRead.rawValue
596:         case "todo_write", "todowrite", "todo_add", "todo_update":
597:             return WebEmulatedTool.todoWrite.rawValue
598:         // Sub-agent / task tool
599:         case "task", "subagent", "agent", "spawn":
600:             return WebEmulatedTool.task.rawValue
601:         // Web fetch (Claude Code WebFetch parity)
602:         case "web_fetch", "webfetch", "fetch", "web_fetch_url", "fetch_url":
603:             return WebEmulatedTool.webFetch.rawValue
604:         // Installed skills (Claude Code Skill parity)
605:         case "skill", "use_skill", "load_skill", "skills":
606:             return WebEmulatedTool.skill.rawValue
607:         // Granular task tools (Claude Code TaskCreate/List/Update parity)
608:         case "task_create", "taskcreate", "create_task", "add_task", "new_task":
609:             return WebEmulatedTool.taskCreate.rawValue
610:         case "task_list", "tasklist", "list_tasks", "tasks", "list_todos":
611:             return WebEmulatedTool.taskList.rawValue
612:         case "task_update", "taskupdate", "update_task", "edit_task", "complete_task":
613:             return WebEmulatedTool.taskUpdate.rawValue
614:         default:
615:             return nil
616:         }
617:     }

619:     /// Normalize a model's argument spellings to this tool's canonical keys.
620:     /// Different model families write `file_path`, `old_string`, `cmd`, etc.
621:     /// Canonical keys always win; unknown keys pass through untouched.
622:     static func normalizedArguments(for tool: WebEmulatedTool,
623:                                     from args: [String: String]) -> [String: String] {
624:         // Canonical key -> accepted spellings (canonical first).
625:         let table: [String: [String]]
626:         switch tool {
627:         case .readFile, .listDir:
628:             table = ["path": ["path", "file_path", "filepath", "file", "filename",
629:                               "target_file", "target", "dir", "directory", "folder", "location"]]
630:         case .editFile:
631:             table = ["path": ["path", "file_path", "filepath", "file", "filename", "target_file"],
632:                      "old": ["old", "old_string", "oldstring", "old_str", "old_text", "search", "find"],
633:                      "new": ["new", "new_string", "newstring", "new_str", "new_text", "replace", "replacement", "replace_with"]]
634:         case .grep:
635:             table = ["pattern": ["pattern", "regex", "regexp", "query", "search_pattern", "text"],
636:                      "path": ["path", "dir", "directory", "folder", "location", "file_path", "filepath", "file"]]
637:         case .glob:
638:             table = ["pattern": ["pattern", "glob_pattern", "glob", "files", "file_pattern", "query"],
639:                      "path": ["path", "dir", "directory", "folder", "location"]]
640:         case .runCommand:
641:             table = ["command": ["command", "cmd", "cmdline", "bash_command", "shell_command", "command_line", "script"]]
642:         case .gitBranch, .gitCheckout:
643:             table = ["branch": ["branch", "branch_name", "new_branch", "target_branch", "ref"],
644:                      "create": ["create"]]
645:         case .gitCommit:
646:             table = ["message": ["message", "commit_message", "msg", "commit_msg", "title"],
647:                      "addAll": ["addAll", "add_all", "all"]]
648:         case .gitPush, .gitPull:
649:             table = ["remote": ["remote", "remote_name"],
650:                      "branch": ["branch", "branch_name", "ref"]]
651:         case .gitLog:
652:             table = ["limit": ["limit", "max_count", "n", "count"],
653:                      "path": ["path"]]
654:         case .gitDiff:
655:             table = ["staged": ["staged"], "path": ["path"]]
656:         case .gitStatus:
657:             table = ["path": ["path"]]
658:         case .todoWrite:
659:             table = ["todos": ["todos", "tasks", "items", "todo_list"]]
660:         case .taskCreate:
661:             table = ["content": ["content", "text", "task", "title", "description", "name", "todo"],

Now I understand the access gate ✓.

Design for task #2 ("путь вне проекта"):

**Problem 1 (model refuses preemptively):** the preamble tells the model it has tools ✓ but doesn't cover the "path outside cwd" case ✓. Fix: add a rule to the preamble ✓: "Paths outside the project are not yours to judge — emit the tool call; the host either returns a validation error or asks the user for access ✓."

**Problem 2 (host behavior):** the tool returns "validation error: pathEscapesProject(...)" ✓ → the model then explains/apologizes ✗. Per the user: the host should ASK for access to the folder outside the project ✓.

So: implement an "access request" flow ✓:
- When validation yields `.pathEscapesProject(path)`, instead of feeding back a dead-end error, the host registers a pending approval asking the user: "Allow the agent to access <path> (outside the project)?" ✓.
- If the user approves ✓ → the tool executes with an extended root (the path's parent + the path ✓) ✓ and the model continues ✓.
- If the user denies ✓ → feed back "validation error: pathEscapesProject(...)" ✓ (as now ✓) plus a hint that the user denied access ✓.

Implementation: the approval flow uses `PendingToolApproval` + `ToolApprovalCenter` ✓ (existing ✓). I need to extend it to carry an "access grant" ✓ — e.g. a new pending approval kind with the extra root ✓, and the executor must use the granted root ✓.

Let me look at the local tool execution code (the executor) to see how projectRoot is used ✓ and where the results are fed back ✓ (lines 1250-1350 and 1420-1530 of ChatPanelView ✓).

Let me read those regions ✓.

3: /// Process-wide queue of tool calls waiting for the user's verdict.
4: ///
5: /// Each direct-model turn registers its approvals before rendering the
6: /// Allow/Deny cards, then awaits them one by one. A verdict may arrive before
7: /// the loop reaches that call (the user can answer queued cards in any
8: /// order), so verdicts are buffered. Sessions are tracked independently:
9: /// stopping one chat denies only that chat's queued calls, while approvals
10: /// from other chats keep waiting. Registrations also carry the assistant
11: /// message ID, so switching back to a chat can reattach its still-pending
12: /// cards after the message history is reloaded from the database.
13: @MainActor
14: final class ToolApprovalCenter {
15:     static let shared = ToolApprovalCenter()
16: 
17:     private struct Registration {
18:         let approval: PendingToolApproval
19:         let sessionID: String
20:         let assistantID: String
21:     }
22: 
23:     private var waiters: [String: CheckedContinuation<Bool, Never>] = [:]
24:     private var bufferedVerdicts: [String: Bool] = [:]
25:     private var registrations: [String: Registration] = [:]
26: 
27:     private init() {}
28: 
29:     /// Registers an approval before its card becomes visible. Must happen
30:     /// before the user can resolve it, otherwise the verdict would be lost.
31:     func register(
32:         _ approval: PendingToolApproval,
33:         sessionID: String,
34:         assistantID: String
35:     ) {
36:         registrations[approval.id] = Registration(
37:             approval: approval,
38:             sessionID: sessionID,
39:             assistantID: assistantID
40:         )
41:     }
42: 
43:     /// Suspends until the user resolves this approval. If a verdict was
44:     /// already buffered, returns it immediately.
45:     func awaitVerdict(id: String) async -> Bool {
46:         if let buffered = bufferedVerdicts.removeValue(forKey: id) {
47:             registrations.removeValue(forKey: id)
48:             return buffered
49:         }
50:         return await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in
51:             if let buffered = bufferedVerdicts.removeValue(forKey: id) {
52:                 registrations.removeValue(forKey: id)
53:                 continuation.resume(returning: buffered)
54:             } else {
55:                 waiters[id] = continuation
56:             }
57:         }
58:     }
59: 
60:     /// Delivers one verdict. A verdict for an approval that is not awaited
61:     /// yet is buffered; later `awaitVerdict(id:)` consumes it.
62:     func resolve(id: String, approved: Bool) {
63:         guard registrations[id] != nil || waiters[id] != nil else { return }
64:         registrations.removeValue(forKey: id)
65:         if let waiter = waiters.removeValue(forKey: id) {
66:             waiter.resume(returning: approved)
67:         } else {
68:             bufferedVerdicts[id] = approved
69:         }
70:     }
71:

73:     /// their pending approvals untouched.
74:     func cancelPending(in sessionID: String) {
75:         let ids = registrations.compactMap { id, registration in
76:             registration.sessionID == sessionID ? id : nil
77:         }
78:         for id in ids {

80:         }
81:     }

--- myCoder/Tests/NewChatSidebarVisibilityTests.swift	
+++ myCoder/Tests/NewChatSidebarVisibilityTests.swift	
@@ -0,0 +1,71 @@
+import Testing
+import Foundation
+@testable import myCoder
+
+/// A newly created chat must show up in the sidebar right away — in its
+/// project or, for a chat without a project, as its own top-level row.
+@Suite("New chats appear in the sidebar")
+struct NewChatSidebarVisibilityTests {
+
+    private func makeTempProjectDir() throws -> String {
+        let dir = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
+            .appendingPathComponent("micoder-sidebar-\(UUID().uuidString)")
+        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: dir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
+        return dir.path
+    }
+
+    @MainActor
+    @Test func projectChatIsListedUnderItsProject() throws {
+        let projectPath = try makeTempProjectDir()
+        defer {
+            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(atPath: projectPath)
+            ProjectDatabaseManager.evictProject(projectPath: projectPath)
+        }
+
+        let appState = AppState()
+        appState.clearInMemoryState()
+        let workspace = appState.addWorkspace(path: projectPath)
+
+        // The sidebar caches a project's chats. The cache must not hide a
+        // chat that was created afterwards.
+        appState.updateSidebarSessions(projectID: workspace.id, sessions: [])
+
+        let sessionID = appState.createLocalSessionForSend(title: "Fresh chat")
+
+        let listed = appState.sidebarSessions(for: workspace)
+        #expect(listed.contains { $0.id == sessionID },
+                "A new chat must be visible in the sidebar of its project")
+    }
+
+    @MainActor
+    @Test func projectlessChatIsListedAsItsOwnRow() throws {
+        let appState = AppState()
+        appState.clearInMemoryState()
+
+        appState.startProjectlessTask()
+        // The sidebar caches the project-less chats too.
+        appState.updateSidebarProjectlessSessions([])
+        let sessionID = appState.createLocalSessionForSend(title: "Loose chat")
+
+        #expect(appState.sidebarProjectlessSessions.contains { $0.id == sessionID },
+                "A chat without a project must be visible in the sidebar")
+    }
+
+    @MainActor
+    @Test func upsertedChatIsListedUnderItsProject() throws {
+        let projectPath = try makeTempProjectDir()
+        defer {
+            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(atPath: projectPath)
+            ProjectDatabaseManager.evictProject(projectPath: projectPath)
+        }
+
+        let appState = AppState()
+        appState.clearInMemoryState()
+        let workspace = appState.addWorkspace(path: projectPath)
+
+        let session = ChatSession(id: UUID().uuidString, title: "Server chat", directory: workspace.path)
+        appState.upsertSession(session)
+
+        #expect(appState.sidebarSessions(for: workspace).contains { $0.id == session.id })
+    }
+}

===================================================================
--- myCoder/Tests/OutOfProjectAccessTests.swift	
+++ myCoder/Tests/OutOfProjectAccessTests.swift	
@@ -0,0 +1,129 @@
+import Testing
+import Foundation
+@testable import myCoder
+
+/// A tool call that points outside the project folder must not dead-end: the
+/// user is asked for access, and an approved grant lets the call run.
+@Suite("Out-of-project access")
+struct OutOfProjectAccessTests {
+
+    private func makeTempDir(_ name: String = UUID().uuidString) throws -> String {
+        let dir = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
+            .appendingPathComponent("micoder-access-\(name)")
+        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: dir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
+        return dir.path
+    }
+
+    @Test("The grant root is the requested folder itself")
+    func grantRootOfDirectory() throws {
+        let dir = try makeTempDir()
+        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(atPath: dir) }
+        #expect(OutOfProjectAccessLogic.grantRoot(forPath: dir) == (dir as NSString).standardizingPath)
+    }
+
+    @Test("The grant root of a file is its parent folder")
+    func grantRootOfFile() throws {
+        let dir = try makeTempDir()
+        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(atPath: dir) }
+        let file = (dir as NSString).appendingPathComponent("notes.md")
+        #expect(OutOfProjectAccessLogic.grantRoot(forPath: file) == (dir as NSString).standardizingPath)
+    }
+
+    @Test("A path outside the project is not accessible without a grant")
+    func outsidePathNeedsGrant() {
+        let accessible = OutOfProjectAccessLogic.isAccessible(
+            path: "/Users/apple/projects/other/file.txt",
+            projectRoot: "/Users/apple/projects/demo"
+        )
+        #expect(accessible == false)
+    }
+
+    @Test("A granted folder makes the path accessible")
+    func grantedFolderIsAccessible() {
+        let accessible = OutOfProjectAccessLogic.isAccessible(
+            path: "/Users/apple/projects/other/file.txt",
+            projectRoot: "/Users/apple/projects/demo",
+            grantedRoots: ["/Users/apple/projects/other"]
+        )
+        #expect(accessible == true)
+    }
+
+    @Test("Validation rejects an outside path without a grant")
+    func validationRejectsOutsidePath() {
+        let call = WebToolCall(name: "read_file", arguments: ["path": "/Users/apple/projects/other/file.txt"])
+        let error = WebToolProtocolEmulator.validate(
+            call,
+            projectRoot: "/Users/apple/projects/demo"
+        )
+        #expect(error == .pathEscapesProject("/Users/apple/projects/other/file.txt"))
+    }
+
+    @Test("Validation accepts an outside path the user granted")
+    func validationAcceptsGrantedPath() {
+        let call = WebToolCall(name: "read_file", arguments: ["path": "/Users/apple/projects/other/file.txt"])
+        let error = WebToolProtocolEmulator.validate(
+            call,
+            projectRoot: "/Users/apple/projects/demo",
+            grantedRoots: ["/Users/apple/projects/other"]
+        )
+        #expect(error == nil)
+    }
+
+    @Test("The executor reads an absolute path outside the project root")
+    func executorReadsAbsolutePath() async throws {
+        let outside = try makeTempDir("outside")
+        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(atPath: outside) }
+        let file = (outside as NSString).appendingPathComponent("note.txt")
+        try "hello from outside".write(toFile: file, atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)
+
+        let project = try makeTempDir("project")
+        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(atPath: project) }
+
+        let executor = ProjectWebToolExecutor(projectRoot: project)
+        let result = await executor.execute(
+            WebToolCall(name: "read_file", arguments: ["path": file]),
+            userApproved: true
+        )
+        #expect(result.contains("hello from outside"))
+    }
+
+    @Test("The executor lists an absolute directory outside the project root")
+    func executorListsAbsoluteDirectory() async throws {
+        let outside = try makeTempDir("outside-dir")
+        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(atPath: outside) }
+        try "x".write(toFile: (outside as NSString).appendingPathComponent("a.txt"),
+                     atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)
+
+        let project = try makeTempDir("project2")
+        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(atPath: project) }
+
+        let executor = ProjectWebToolExecutor(projectRoot: project)
+        let result = await executor.execute(
+            WebToolCall(name: "list_dir", arguments: ["path": outside]),
+            userApproved: true
+        )
+        #expect(result.contains("a.txt"))
+    }
+
+    @Test("The approval message names the tool, the path and the project")
+    func approvalMessageContent() {
+        let message = OutOfProjectAccessLogic.approvalMessage(
+            tool: "read_file",
+            path: "/Users/apple/projects/other/file.txt",
+            projectRoot: "/Users/apple/projects/demo"
+        )
+        #expect(message.contains("read_file"))
+        #expect(message.contains("/Users/apple/projects/other/file.txt"))
+        #expect(message.contains("/Users/apple/projects/demo"))
+    }
+
+    @Test("The denial message tells the model to stop retrying")
+    func denialMessageContent() {
+        let message = OutOfProjectAccessLogic.denialMessage(
+            tool: "read_file",
+            path: "/Users/apple/projects/other/file.txt"
+        )
+        #expect(message.contains("denied"))
+        #expect(message.contains("Do not retry"))
+    }
+}

/// Insert a chat into the sidebar caches so a new chat shows up right away.
@MainActor
func registerSessionInSidebar(_ session: ChatSession) {
    if session.directory == ChatSession.standaloneProjectKey {
        var list = sidebarProjectlessSessions
        list.removeAll { $0.id == session.id }

}

+import Testing
+import Foundation
+@testable import myCoder
+
+/// The model emitted a ```tool block with a very large payload and the host
+/// did not execute it. These tests cover the shapes that broke the parser.
+@Suite("Tool block parsing — large payloads")
+struct ToolBlockLargePayloadTests {
+
+    private func largeToolBlock(path: String, content: String) -> String {
+        let payload: [String: Any] = [
+            "name": "write_file",
+            "args": ["path": path, "content": content]
+        ]
+        let data = try! JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: payload)
+        let json = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) ?? "{}"
+        return """
+        I will now emit the `write_file` tool and **stop talking completely** so the host can execute it.
+
+        ```tool
+        \(json)
+        ```
+        """
+    }
+
+    @Test("A large single-line payload is parsed")
+    func largePayloadIsParsed() {
+        let content = String(repeating: "line with <html lang=\"en\"> and \\n escapes; ", count: 400)
+        let text = largeToolBlock(path: "project_comparison.html", content: content)
+        let calls = WebToolProtocolEmulator.parseToolCalls(from: text)
+        #expect(calls.count == 1)
+        #expect(calls.first?.name == "write_file")
+        #expect(calls.first?.arguments["path"] == "project_comparison.html")
+        #expect(calls.first?.arguments["content"]?.count == content.count)
+    }
+
+    @Test("A payload with real newlines inside the JSON string is rejected by JSONSerialization")
+    func payloadWithRealNewlinesFails() {
+        let text = """
+        ```tool
+        {"name": "write_file", "args": {"path": "a.html", "content": "line1
+        line2"}}
+        ```
+        """
+        let calls = WebToolProtocolEmulator.parseToolCalls(from: text)
+        #expect(calls.isEmpty, "A JSON string with a raw newline is not valid JSON")
+    }
+
+    @Test("A payload with raw newlines is still recovered as a tool call")
+    func payloadWithRawNewlinesIsRecovered() {
+        let text = """
+        ```tool
+        {"name": "write_file", "args": {"path": "a.html", "content": "line1
+        line2"}}
+        ```
+        """
+        let calls = WebToolProtocolEmulator.parseToolCalls(from: text)
+        #expect(calls.isEmpty == false, "The tool call must still reach the host")
+    }
+
+    @Test("A payload with escaped quotes and backslashes is parsed")
+    func payloadWithEscapesIsParsed() {
+        let content = "a \"quoted\" word and a backslash \\ and a newline \n"
+        let text = largeToolBlock(path: "x.html", content: content)
+        let calls = WebToolProtocolEmulator.parseToolCalls(from: text)
+        #expect(calls.count == 1)
+        #expect(calls.first?.arguments["content"] == content)
+    }
+}

if [ -f "$PROXY_DIR/proxies.db" ]; then
 while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
  # Only SOCKS proxies — HTTP proxies require CONNECT which is unreliable
  case "$line" in

import sqlite3, os
avoid = [c.strip().upper() for c in os.environ.get('PROXY_AVOID_CC', '').split(',') if len(c.strip()) == 2]
db = sqlite3.connect(os.environ['PROXY_DB_PATH'])
q = \"SELECT scheme,ip,port FROM proxies WHERE is_working=1 AND (scheme='socks5' OR scheme='socks4')\"
if avoid:
    q += ' AND (country IS NULL OR country NOT IN (%s))' % ','.join(\"'%s'\" % c for c in avoid)
q += ' ORDER BY avg_speed ASC'
for s, ip, p in db.execute(q):
    print(f'{s}://{ip}:{p}')
db.close()
" 2>/dev/null || true)
fi

if [ -f "$PROXY_DIR/proxies.txt" ]; then
 while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do

   *) : ;;
  esac
 done < "$PROXY_DIR/proxies.txt"
fi
echo "Pool candidates: ${#ADDRS[@]} (${DB_WORKING_COUNT} proven-working from DB)"

 exit 1
fi
pkill -f "pool-linux" 2>/dev/null || true
pkill -f "http2socks.py" 2>/dev/null || true
for ATTEMPT in $(seq 1 "$MAX_PROXY_ATTEMPTS"); do
 echo "Proxy pool attempt ${ATTEMPT}/${MAX_PROXY_ATTEMPTS} (${#ADDRS[@]} candidates)..."
 if [ "$POOL_IS_GO" = "1" ]; then
  "$PROXY_DIR/pool" "${ADDRS[@]}" > /tmp/http2socks.log 2>&1 &
 else
  python3 "$PROXY_DIR/http2socks.py" "${ADDRS[@]}" > /tmp/http2socks.log 2>&1 &
 fi
 POOL_PID=$!
  # Server starts instantly; trigger RELOAD to pull fresh working proxies from DB,

  sleep 2
  python3 -c "
import socket
try:
    s=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',18081),3)
    s.sendall(b'RELOAD')
    print('RELOAD sent')
except Exception as e: print(f'RELOAD fail: {e}')
" 2>/dev/null
  sleep 3
  POOL_OK=0
  for POLL in $(seq 1 20); do
   if curl -x "http://127.0.0.1:${POOL_PORT}" -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 20 https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/models 2>/dev/null | grep -q 200; then
    echo "Proxy pool: opencode.ai reachable (models catalog 200 via :${POOL_PORT})"
    POOL_OK=1
    break
   fi

   POOL_STATS=$(python3 -c "
import socket
try:
    s = socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1', 18081), 2)

except Exception:
    print('mgmt-unreachable')
" 2>/dev/null)

   echo "  poll ${POLL}/20: ${POOL_STATS:-?} :: ${LAST_CONN:-validating...}"

  sleep 2
 done

    kill "$WARP_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    sleep 3
   fi
  else

   cat /tmp/warp.log 2>/dev/null | tail -5
   sleep 3
  fi
 done
 if [ "$WARP_OK" != "1" ]; then
  echo "FATAL: WARP failed after ${MAX_WARP_ATTEMPTS} attempts."
  echo "Refusing to run direct (would leak IP / burn rate limit). Exit."
  exit 1
 fi
else

 echo "Refusing to run direct. Exit."

fi

  else
   echo "gost failed"
   GOST_PID=""
  fi
 fi
fi

# --- Proxy env vars ---
if [ -n "$GOST_PID" ]; then
 export HTTP_PROXY="http://127.0.0.1:18080"
 export HTTPS_PROXY="http://127.0.0.1:18080"
 export ALL_PROXY="http://127.0.0.1:18080"
 export http_proxy="http://127.0.0.1:18080"
 export https_proxy="http://127.0.0.1:18080"

1: # OpenCode free tier: Desktop и Docker, 24 октября 2026
2: 
3: ## Результат
4: 
5: Фраза `upstream gate, verified live` зашита в myCoder и не является дословной ошибкой модели. В streaming-клиенте myCoder обнаружена потеря тела HTTP-ошибки: любой HTTP 400/403 мог превращаться в утверждение о запрете сторонних клиентов.
6: 
7: На скриншоте OpenCode Desktop другая ситуация: `Free usage exceeded, subscribe to Go` и обратный отсчёт. Это сообщение об исчерпанной бесплатной квоте. Пользователь подтвердил, что в Desktop оно возникает на всех бесплатных моделях. Нельзя сводить наблюдение к разным выбранным моделям.
8: 
9: Доказательств новой аппаратной привязки в исследованном коде нет. Причина расхождения квоты Desktop и Docker **не установлена до конкретного правила серверного счётчика**. Правила нового inference-сервиса отсутствуют в исследованном публичном дереве; подмена идентификаторов и сброс квот не выполнялись.
10: 
11: ## Что проверено на этой машине
12: 
13: | Параметр | macOS Desktop | Linux Docker |
14: | --- | --- | --- |
15: | Фактическая версия | 1.19.4: Info.plist и встроенный backend в app.asar | **1.18.14**, проверено `/usr/bin/opencode --version`; первоначальное 1.18.4 неточно |
16: | Backend | Встроенный Node sidecar, протокол v1 | Активный TUI `opencode`, Linux x86_64 |
17: | Авторизация OpenCode | Нет opencode/opencode-go в auth.json; нет OPENCODE_API_KEY; таблицы аккаунтов/credentials пусты | Нет auth.json/API-key env; таблицы аккаунтов/credentials пусты |
18: | Явные proxy env | Не обнаружены у backend | Не обнаружены у TUI |
19: | Выходной IPv4 контрольного запроса | Совпадает с Docker | Совпадает с macOS |
20: | Каталог opencode / Big Pickle / DeepSeek Free | `https://opencode.ai/inference/openai/v1` | `https://opencode.ai/inference/openai/v1` |
21: | Текущее поведение | На скрине общая free quota exhausted; подтверждено пользователем для всех free моделей | В БД есть завершённый `opencode/big-pickle`, `finish=stop`, без error, **24 октября 19:30:07 Bangkok** |
22: 
23: Отдельный macOS CLI `/usr/local/bin/opencode` имеет версию 1.18.29. Он не является встроенным backend Desktop.
24: 
25: На втором скриншоте пользователь также показал успешный ответ Big Pickle из терминального OpenCode **на самом Mac**, cwd `/Users/apple`. Проверка активного процесса подтвердила executable `/usr/local/Cellar/opencode/1.18.29/bin/opencode` и версию **1.18.29**. В БД соответствующий assistant завершён без ошибки 24 октября **19:44:47 Bangkok**. Это дополнительное наблюдение против общей блокировки компьютера: Desktop и Mac TUI на одном хосте ведут себя по-разному.
26: 
27: Одинаковый IP контрольного запроса не заменяет трассировку конкретного запроса модели: остаются неизвестными фактический выбор IPv4/IPv6, TLS fingerprint и серверный bucket. Значения IP и credentials в отчёт не включены.
28:

Каталог проверен локально, но итоговый запрос активного Desktop не перехватывался; его сгенерированный локальный пароль и память процесса не извлекались. Свежая ошибка квоты со скриншота не найдена среди завершённых assistant errors в БД, поэтому её точные HTTP status/error.type/Retry-After здесь не подтверждены.
30: 
31: ## Контроль версии 1.19.4 в Docker
32: 
33: Основная установка и активный TUI Docker **не обновлялись**. В отдельной временной папке был скачан официальный Linux x64 release v1.19.4 и выполнен ровно один запрос Big Pickle с просьбой ответить OK без инструментов. SHA256 архива совпал с опубликованным в GitHub release: `849bd6b3d959a1d2ef200ed1634a51c79a45ca236aa26665d75debd694805cce`.
34: 
35: Результат: version=1.19.4, finish=stop, responseOK=true, tool_use=0, error=0. Заголовки, endpoint, proxy и IP не переопределялись. Активная БД старой версии не использовалась: config/data/state/cache находились во временном каталоге, config был скопирован без изменения, credentials отсутствовали.
36: 
37: Это показывает, что версии 1.19.4 и того же внешнего IP недостаточно для воспроизведения Desktop quota. Изолированное состояние может менять session/client context, поэтому контроль не устанавливает точный серверный ключ квоты и не доказывает отсутствие любого дополнительного вида привязки.
38: 
39: ## Заголовки официального клиента
40: 
41: Сопоставлены фактические теги:
42: 
43: - v1.18.14: `65cf14df16c191f3e9684f0d9a8bae69103ced6d`.
44: - v1.19.4: `148842ef7cb1bc34192b3fff57d0f9721ab9c801`.
45: - Дополнительно первоначально названный v1.18.4: `49c69c5ed3ccf706b61b3febb43c8aaff7f8325e`.
46:
